assets.name: HomeBackdrop
assets.prompt: Edit target/reference: supplied Pocket Bloom A UI concept. Create ONLY the left HOME garden BACKGROUND illustration as a production 2D mobile UI asset, portrait 9:16. No UI, words, text, logos, panels, cards, buttons, counters or puzzle tiles anywhere. Faithfully preserve the sunlit watercolor storybook garden style, white-and-orange sleeping kitten on stone steps, blue sky, white/yellow daisies, pink cosmos, lavender flowers, leafy arch, cottage in the distance, warm sage/coral/ivory palette. Full bleed art, no border outside image. Layout for UI overlay: clean pale-blue sky opening in upper center at y12-35% reserved for a logo; sleeping ginger-and-white kitten on stone step near central y45-53%, prominent but not giant; the lower third has calm pale stone path and light garden surface in the center, flowers mostly along left/right edges, allowing real buttons to be placed over it. Keep background behind UI areas relatively simple. Charming painterly detailed garden, soft morning light. Render a complete natural scene underneath where the original buttons were, remove every original interface element. Exact visual family of A HOME, not B clay style.
